title: Level 3 (Advanced) - D-1
notes:
West leads the ♠3 against 3NT. South has 8 top tricks (1 spade, given the lead, 2 hearts, 2 diamonds, and 3 clubs). At first glance it appears South will need a favorable break in one of the minors in order to come to 9 tricks.

South receives a break, however, when East plays the ♠A at trick 1 (the contract cannot be made if East ducks). South should unblock his ♠K under East's ♠A! If East returns a heart South must be careful to win this trick in the closed hand. South's remaining spade is led to drive out the ♠Q, establishing 2 spade winners in the dummy with the ♥A as an entry to cash them.

Unblocking the ♠K at trick 1 ensures the contract. This play gives up an immediate spade winner, but ensures that the dummy will be able to win 2 spade tricks later in the play.
